entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave Togo.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después de la fecha en que planees salir de Togo.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave Togo.

entry.en: You must have a visa to visit Togo, and a single-entry tourist visa is valid for 15 days.
entry.es: Debes tener visa para visitar Togo, y una visa turística de entrada única es válida por 15 días.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to visit Togo. A single-entry tourist visa is valid for 15 days.

entry.en: You must apply for a visa at least 6 days before arriving, and you cannot get one on arrival.
entry.es: Debes solicitar la visa al menos 6 días antes de llegar, y no se puede obtener a la llegada.
entry.quote: You must apply for a visa at least 6 days before you plan to arrive in the country. You cannot get a visa on arrival.

entry.en: You must get a visa if you are travelling through Togo.
entry.es: Debes obtener una visa si viajas en tránsito por Togo.
entry.quote: You must get a visa if you’re travelling through Togo.

entry.en: You must fill in a registration certificate online before you arrive in and depart from Togo.
entry.es: Debes completar en línea un certificado de registro antes de llegar a Togo y antes de salir.
entry.quote: You must fill in a registration certificate online before you arrive in and depart from Togo.

entry.en: To enter Togo you must have a certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination.
entry.es: Para entrar a Togo debes tener un certificado que pruebe la vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla.
entry.quote: To enter Togo, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Togo.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Togo.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Togo.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel within 5km of the Burkina Faso border because of the security situation and kidnapping risk.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 5 km de la frontera con Burkina Faso por la situación de seguridad y el riesgo de secuestro.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to within 5km of the border with Burkina Faso, due to the security situation in Burkina Faso and the risk of kidnapping in the region.

safety.en: Violent crime, theft and pickpocketing are common, particularly on the beaches and markets of Lomé.
safety.es: El crimen violento, los robos y los carteristas son comunes, sobre todo en las playas y mercados de Lomé.
safety.quote: Violent crime, theft and pickpocketing are common in Togo, particularly on the beaches and markets of Lomé.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual relationships are illegal in Togo and penalties are severe.
safety.es: Las relaciones sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Togo y las penas son severas.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual relationships are illegal in Togo and penalties are severe.

safety.en: Ocean currents are very strong along the coast and there are a number of drownings each year.
safety.es: Las corrientes oceánicas son muy fuertes en la costa y hay varios ahogamientos cada año.
safety.quote: Ocean currents are very strong along the coast and there are a number of drownings each year.

safety.en: Traffic is described as the single biggest danger to travelers in Togo.
safety.es: El tráfico se describe como el mayor peligro para los viajeros en Togo.
safety.quote: Traffic is the single biggest danger to travelers in Togo.

health.en: Medical facilities are poor and emergency facilities are extremely limited.
health.es: Los centros médicos son deficientes y las instalaciones de emergencia son extremadamente limitadas.
health.quote: Medical facilities are poor. Emergency facilities are extremely limited.

health.en: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds for medical treatment abroad and repatriation.
health.es: Asegúrate de tener un seguro médico de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles para tratamiento médico en el extranjero y repatriación.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

health.en: Pharmacies are widely available and usually identified by a green cross.
health.es: Las farmacias abundan y suelen identificarse con una cruz verde.
health.quote: Pharmacies are widely available and are usually identified by a green cross.

health.en: Staying away from roadside meals is advised if possible.
health.es: Se aconseja evitar las comidas callejeras junto a la carretera si es posible.
health.quote: Stay away from roadside meals if possible.

health.en: Wikivoyage advises drinking bottled water such as Volta or sachets of "Pure Water".
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja beber agua embotellada como Volta o sobres de "Pure Water".
health.quote: Drink bottled water such as Volta or sachets of "Pure Water".

help.en: Emergency numbers are 8200 for ambulance, 118 for fire and 117 or 177 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 8200 para ambulancia, 118 para bomberos y 117 o 177 para la policía.

help.en: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Puedes llamar al FCDO en Londres si necesitas ayuda urgente porque algo le ha pasado a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

getting_in.en: Several airlines offer regular flights to Lomé (LFW).
getting_in.es: Varias aerolíneas ofrecen vuelos regulares a Lomé (LFW).
getting_in.quote: Several airlines offer regular flights to Lomé (LFW IATA).

getting_in.en: You can fly to Accra in Ghana and take a bus from Accra to the border at Aflao.
getting_in.es: Puedes volar a Accra, en Ghana, y tomar un bus de Accra a la frontera en Aflao.
getting_in.quote: You can also fly to Accra airport in Ghana then get a comfortable, air-conditioned, and reasonably priced bus from Accra to the border at Aflao.

getting_in.en: At Aflao, people must walk across the border into Lomé and find their own transport inside Togo.
getting_in.es: En Aflao hay que cruzar a pie la frontera hacia Lomé y buscar transporte propio dentro de Togo.
getting_in.quote: At Aflao, people must walk across the border into Lomé and find their own transport inside Togo.

getting_in.en: From either Accra or Benin, you can take bush taxis to Lomé for US$5.
getting_in.es: Desde Accra o Benín puedes tomar taxis colectivos a Lomé por 5 dólares.
getting_in.quote: From either Accra or Benin, you can take bush taxis for US$5 to Lomé.

getting_in.en: There are overland buses from Burkina Faso, Ghana and Benin.
getting_in.es: Hay buses por tierra desde Burkina Faso, Ghana y Benín.
getting_in.quote: There are overland buses from Burkina Faso, Ghana and Benin.

getting_around.en: A taxi-moto (motorcycle taxi) will cost CFA 150-500 to get you around.
getting_around.es: Un taxi-moto (mototaxi) costará entre 150 y 500 CFA para moverte.
getting_around.quote: A taxi-moto (motorcycle taxi) will cost CFA 150-500 to get you around.

getting_around.en: A taxi usually costs about CFA 500 for a short one-way city trip and up to CFA 2,500 to the northern parts of the city.
getting_around.es: Un taxi suele costar unos 500 CFA por un trayecto corto en la ciudad y hasta 2,500 CFA hacia el norte de la ciudad.
getting_around.quote: A taxi will usually cost about CFA 500 for a one-way short trip inside the city, for trips to the northern parts of the city expect to pay up to CFA 2,500.

getting_around.en: Always negotiate before getting in, as the quoted price will include the tip.
getting_around.es: Negocia siempre antes de subir, ya que el precio ofrecido incluye la propina.
getting_around.quote: Always negotiate before you get on/in, the quoted price will include tip.

getting_around.en: Taxis have yellow licence plates and their registration number painted on the car.
getting_around.es: Los taxis tienen placas amarillas y su número de registro pintado en el coche.
getting_around.quote: Taxis will have yellow licence plates and their registration number painted on the car.

getting_around.en: There is no train service in Togo.
getting_around.es: No hay servicio de tren en Togo.
getting_around.quote: There is no train service in Togo.

money.en: Togo is a cash-based society, so bring enough cash for your visit, as credit cards are not widely accepted.
money.es: Togo es una sociedad basada en efectivo, así que lleva suficiente para tu visita, pues las tarjetas de crédito no se aceptan ampliamente.
money.quote: Togo is a cash-based society so bring enough cash with you to cover your visit. Credit cards are not widely accepted.

money.en: Some ATMs in the capital, Lomé, accept international cards and dispense local currency.
money.es: Algunos cajeros en la capital, Lomé, aceptan tarjetas internacionales y entregan moneda local.
money.quote: Some ATMs in the capital, Lomé, accept international cards and dispense local currency.

money.en: The currency is the West African CFA franc (XOF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Occidental (XOF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the West African CFA franc, denoted CFA (ISO currency code: XOF).

money.en: The CFA franc is fixed at 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.
money.es: El franco CFA está fijado a 1 euro = 655,957 francos CFA.
money.quote: Both currencies are fixed at a rate of 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.

money.en: All Ecobank and Banque Atlantique ATMs in Togo take Mastercard and Visa for cash withdrawal.
money.es: Todos los cajeros de Ecobank y Banque Atlantique en Togo aceptan Mastercard y Visa para retirar efectivo.
money.quote: All Ecobank and Banque Atlantique ATMs in Togo take Master card and Visa card for cash withdrawal.

money.en: A liter of gasoline costs around CFA 600 and a liter of water around CFA 300.
money.es: Un litro de gasolina cuesta unos 600 CFA y un litro de agua unos 300 CFA.
money.quote: A liter of gasoline will cost you around CFA 600, a liter of water around CFA 300.

etiquette.en: Greetings are a little more elaborate in Togo: say hello to everyone when coming and going, and handshakes are key.
etiquette.es: Los saludos son algo más elaborados en Togo: saluda a todos al llegar y al irte, y el apretón de manos es clave.
etiquette.quote: Greetings are a little more elaborate in Togo. Say hello to everyone when coming and going. Handshakes are key.

connectivity.en: There are quite a lot of wifi zones, charging from CFA 100 for an hour to CFA 2000-3000 for a month.
connectivity.es: Hay bastantes zonas wifi, que cobran desde 100 CFA por hora hasta 2000-3000 CFA por mes.
connectivity.quote: You also have quite a lot of "wifi zones", charging from CFA 100 for an hour to CFA 2000-3000 for a month.

connectivity.en: If you come from Ghana and stay close to the border, your Ghana SIM card will work, with no need to buy a Togolese one.
connectivity.es: Si vienes de Ghana y te quedas cerca de la frontera, tu SIM de Ghana funcionará sin necesidad de comprar una togolesa.
connectivity.quote: If you come from Ghana and stay close to the border, your Ghana SIM card will work perfectly, no need to buy a Togolese one.

connectivity.en: Lomé has Internet cafes, and they are cheap.
connectivity.es: Lomé tiene cibercafés y son baratos.
connectivity.quote: Lomé has Internet cafes, and they are cheap.
